cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep the breakfast score. My tea's stronger than yours, and I don't need milk to manage it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same pot. I added milk so I could drink mine sooner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then speed counts. We can use your standard; I've only got two mouthfuls left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've finished. I'm having another, not waiting for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, no waiting required. We'll count refills instead. You choose how long breakfast lasts; I can keep these two mouthfuls going and still give you a proper result.

reason: Have A preserve scorekeeper confidence by accepting B speed rationale and refusal to wait, granting timing control while switching to the refill contest A intends to win.
